workarounds: El Progreso's base RSS URL is malformed and returns nothing parseable; used https://www.elprogreso.es/rss/lugo/ for local discovery instead.
El Progreso article pages return 403 to curl (Cloudflare), so their body text was read through web_extract rather than a direct fetch.
Two national stories were initially matched to guessed article URLs that returned 404; both were replaced with the exact links taken from the cached Europa Press and elDiario.es feeds.

The Guardian's image host returned 401 for the Palantir/NHS lead image because its URLs are signed; per photo policy the story ships with an empty imageURL and the category gradient rather than being dropped.

Ars Technica's piece about an OpenAI Foundation board member warning that AI is 'the most likely reason you'll die' is about Paul Cristiano, not Helen Toner; it was removed from the Toner story's sources to avoid a mis-citation, and wersm and explainX were used as the second and third sources.
The Northern Ireland unity story's third source (Belfast Telegraph) returns 403 to curl, treated as a bot-block and therefore inconclusive rather than a dead link.
notes: Heavy geopolitical day: a first trilateral Trump-Putin-Xi meeting at Apec and a US proposal on the Donbas framed the global section. 18 of 19 stories carry the outlet's own photograph. Six sections, 19 stories, published in a single run with no retries needed after the first merge.
